feature: Confirm a Permission by Envelope Only

userStories.title: Define Permission confirm contract and schemas
userStories.description: As a workflow developer, I want canonical schemas for Permission confirmation and persistence input, so that the engine, database, operations, and server layers share strict type contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/workflows/src/schemas/pending-interaction.ts exports permissionConfirmBodySchema, PermissionConfirmBody, confirmPendingPermissionInputSchema, and ConfirmPendingPermissionInput using z from @hono/zod-openapi and z.infer.
permissionConfirmBodySchema is strict and accepts only an object with an intent string containing at least one non-whitespace character, preserving surrounding whitespace verbatim without trimming.
permissionConfirmBodySchema rejects empty objects, empty string intent, whitespace-only intent, non-string intent, extra unexpected fields, and ask-style structures (such as decline or answers).
confirmPendingPermissionInputSchema accepts strictly workflow_run_id, tool_use_id, answer (validating against permissionConfirmBodySchema), and resolved_by, rejecting any extraneous fields.
Existing schemas pendingInteractionSchema, askAnswerBodySchema, and resolvePendingInteractionInputSchema in pending-interaction.ts remain unchanged.
packages/workflows/src/schemas/pending-interaction.test.ts verifies all permission schema constraints, type inferences, and invalid body rejections.
Focused test runs pass via bun test src/schemas/pending-interaction.test.ts in packages/workflows.

userStories.title: Implement atomic Permission confirmation CAS and safe event logging
userStories.description: As an operator, I want pending Permission interactions confirmed atomically with run resumption when no pending interactions remain, so that first write wins, sibling interactions are respected, and no intent strings leak.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/core/src/db/workflow-pending-interactions.ts exports confirmPendingPermission(input: ConfirmPendingPermissionInput): Promise<ResolvePendingInteractionResult> and adds 'kind_not_permission' to PendingInteractionValidationCode.

confirmPendingPermission validates input against confirmPendingPermissionInputSchema and throws PendingInteractionValidationError('invalid_body') for invalid shapes or whitespace-only intents before opening a transaction.
confirmPendingPermission executes inside db.withTransaction, locking workflow run and pending interaction rows using workflowRunLockClause (FOR UPDATE in PostgreSQL).

Throws PendingInteractionNotFoundError if the run or interaction row does not exist, PendingInteractionAlreadyResolvedError if the interaction status is not 'pending', PendingInteractionRunNotPausedError if the run status is not 'paused', and PendingInteractionValidationError('kind_not_permission') if current.kind !== 'permission'.

Performs a CAS update on remote_agent_pending_interactions setting status = 'answered', answer = JSON.stringify(answer), resolved_at = dialect.now(), and resolved_by = resolvedBy; throws PendingInteractionAlreadyResolvedError if rowCount === 0.

Queries remaining pending interactions count: if remaining is zero, invokes resumeWorkflowRunInTransaction(query, workflowRunId, dialect, 'paused-ask') and sets resumed = true; throws PendingInteractionRunNotPausedError if resume CAS fails.

Inserts an interaction_resolved audit event via insertWorkflowEvent with data containing strictly { node_id, tool_use_id, kind: 'permission', resumed } and step_name = node_id, guaranteeing atomic commit or rollback with the interaction and resume.
Neither the submitted intent value, answer payload, nor envelope payload ever appears in structured logs, persisted events, or thrown errors.
Existing resolvePendingInteraction remains Ask-only and continues to reject Permission rows with 'kind_not_ask'.
All tests in packages/core/src/db/workflow-pending-interactions.test.ts and packages/core/src/db/workflows.resume-cas.integration.test.ts pass against real SQLite.

userStories.title: Authorize Permission confirmation operations and update DB mocks
userStories.description: As a workflow operations layer, I want starter-authorized permission confirmation that emits live events and logs safely post-commit, so that only the run starter can confirm and consumers receive truthful signals.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/core/src/operations/workflow-operations.ts exports PermissionRunNotFoundError, PermissionAuthenticationRequiredError, PermissionForbiddenError, ConfirmPermissionInput, ConfirmPermissionResult, and confirmPermission(input: ConfirmPermissionInput): Promise<ConfirmPermissionResult>.
confirmPermission requires an authenticated actorUserId (throws PermissionAuthenticationRequiredError with exact message 'Authentication required' if undefined or empty string).

confirmPermission loads the run via workflowDb.getWorkflowRun(runId); throws PermissionRunNotFoundError with exact message 'Workflow run not found: <runId>' if missing; logs errorName and runId as operations.workflow_permission_lookup_failed and throws 'Failed to look up workflow run <runId>' on DB failure without leaking raw errors.

confirmPermission validates that run.user_id !== null and run.user_id === actorUserId; throws PermissionForbiddenError with exact message 'Not allowed to confirm permission for run <runId>' for non-starters (including admins) or unowned runs.
confirmPermission delegates to confirmPendingPermission passing runId, callId (as tool_use_id), body (as answer), and actorUserId (as resolved_by) exactly once.

confirmPermission logs workflow.permission_resolved with { workflowRunId, nodeId, toolUseId, resumed } and emits interaction_resolved via getWorkflowEventEmitter().emit({ type: 'interaction_resolved', runId, nodeId, resumed }) only after the persistence transaction commits.
No intent string, answer payload, or envelope payload reaches logger or emitter payloads on success or failure.

All mock factories for @archon/core/db/workflow-pending-interactions across packages/core/src/operations/workflow-operations.test.ts, packages/server/src/routes/api.workflow-runs.test.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/workflow.test.ts, and packages/cli/src/commands/workflow-command-contract.test.ts export confirmPendingPermission.

Focused test runs pass via bun test in packages/core for workflow-operations.test.ts, packages/server for api.workflow-runs.test.ts, and packages/cli for workflow.test.ts and workflow-command-contract.test.ts.

userStories.title: Register authenticated OpenAPI route for Permission confirmation
userStories.description: As an API consumer, I want an authenticated POST route to confirm a permission interaction by callId, so that the HTTP API conforms to OpenAPI and maps errors securely.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/server/src/routes/schemas/workflow.schemas.ts exports permissionConfirmRequestSchema = permissionConfirmBodySchema.openapi('PermissionConfirmBody').

packages/server/src/routes/api.ts registers POST /api/workflows/runs/{runId}/permissions/{callId}/confirm using registerOpenApiRoute with confirmPermissionRoute and response schema workflowRunActionResponseSchema.
The route applies pre-validation authentication middleware returning 401 'Authentication required' before body parsing when resolveAuthContext yields no requester.
Valid confirmation by the starter returns 200 with { success: true, message: ... }, indicating whether other interactions remain.

Maps typed errors to HTTP status codes: PermissionAuthenticationRequiredError to 401, PermissionForbiddenError to 403, PermissionRunNotFoundError and PendingInteractionNotFoundError to 404, PendingInteractionAlreadyResolvedError and PendingInteractionRunNotPausedError to 409, and PendingInteractionValidationError to 400.
Unexpected failures return 500 with { error: 'Failed to confirm permission' } and log api.workflow_permission_confirm_failed without logging intent or raw error details.
The handler does not invoke tryAutoResumeAfterGate, dispatchToOrchestrator, or resumeWorkflowRun.
The OpenAPI document at /api/openapi.json exposes the POST /api/workflows/runs/{runId}/permissions/{callId}/confirm route and PermissionConfirmBody component schema.
All route tests in packages/server/src/routes/api.workflow-runs.test.ts pass.
